typecheck.description: tsc (TypeScript 7 with the Effect language service) for the package and what it depends on

test.description: Vitest for the package; runs without hardware. Starts at once (Node strips the types, so no typecheck comes first) and reruns when a package it depends on changes

sources.description: No script: a transit node that carries a change in a package's sources to the tests of the packages that depend on it, without making them wait for anything

//#lint.description: oxlint over the whole repository (the root's lint script), beside the other tasks and cached: it reruns when any file that is not Markdown changes

build.description: Static export of a Next.js app (the status page into apps/web/out); cached, so pnpm gateway rebuilds the page only when it changed

start.description: Runs the package (the gateway); not cached
